text: Before you reprimand your child, take a deep breath. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Indeed, Allah is Rafeeq (Most Kind) and loves rifq (gentleness) in all things' — and rifq begins with the tone of your voice before your words.

review_defects.arabic: إن الله رفيق يحب الرفق في كل شيء
review_defects.english: Indeed, Allah is Rafeeq (Most Kind) and loves rifq (gentleness) in all things
review_defects.why: The Arabic says 'رفيق' (Rafeeq, meaning gentle/kind) without the superlative 'Most'. The English adds 'Most Kind', which is an intensification not present in the original hadith.
